user_prompt: We need to ensure our supply chain partners can deliver the materials we need on time and at the right cost. Our goal is to have complete visibility into what we've committed to buy from each supplier and be confident that those commitments will be fulfilled according to our specifications.

steps.step_name: We need to ensure our supply chain partners can deliver the materials we need on time and at the right cost. Our goal is to have complete visibility into what we've committed to buy from each supplier and be confident that those commitments will be fulfilled according to our specifications.

args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
- corp.itsm: IT service management (incident analysis, asset provisioning) - INTERNAL focus
- sap.ariba: Procurement/supply chain - Purchase Order Network API for supplier visibility & fulfillment tracking
- sap.s4: ERP (procurement, BOM compliance, asset lifecycle)
- siemens.plm: PLM systems (BOM compliance, engineering change coordination)
- sap.ehs: Safety/EHS (safety compliance automation for engineering changes & materials)
- workday.hcm: HR/HCM
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors - workforce planning
- emarsys.cx: CX/engagement (marketing campaigns, vendor engagement orchestration)
- my.mes: MES (manufacturing execution, production change, quality monitoring)
- sap.crm: Sales/CRM (opportunity qualification, sales compensation)
- sap.odm: Entity type taxonomy

KEY FINDINGS:
- PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (sap.ariba:apiResource:PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI:v1) = primary for supplier commitment visibility, PO management, fulfillment tracking, vendor compliance verification
- SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator (sap.ehs) = safety validation on engineering changes + materials
- BOMComplianceValidator (siemens.plm, my.mes, sap.s4) = BOM-specific compliance validation
- ProductionChangeOrchestrator (my.mes) = production change coordination, work order sequencing, synchronized updates

CONFIRMED GAPS:
- No customer issue tracking/case management
- No maintenance management system / service work order tracking for equipment maintenance

args.reason: Provides complete visibility into purchase orders and supplier commitments with real-time status tracking, vendor compliance verification, and specification management across the supplier network.
